items.quote: Shane has the rare gift of disappearing and reappearing at exactly the right moments. We didn't pose for him — we lived our day, and he gathered the small, true things. Looking through the gallery felt like reading our own love letter.

We told Shane we wanted images that would still feel right in twenty years. He delivered photographs that already feel like memory. Quiet, warm, almost film-like. Our parents wept when we showed them the album.

Calm under pressure, kind to every relative, and somehow every photograph holds a feeling. Shane caught a single look between my dad and me that I would otherwise have lost. That image alone is worth everything.
Booking Shane was the single best decision we made for our wedding. He felt like a friend by the morning — present, unhurried, with an eye that finds beauty in the unscripted middle of the day.
Our elopement was just the two of us, the Gulf, and Shane. The photographs feel like a private film made for us. We have framed three above our bed.
